method: Worker B, same AI, separate source-first pass. Began again with the dated compulsory curriculum, choice rules and actual course entries, especially project admission, then reconsidered the exact completed UCR selections, contribution claims and alignments from the active workbook. Read the final audience selections and descriptions through the established mapping. This analytical pass is not an independent person or a runtime rendering test.
findings: The current programme page now also discusses the next admissions cycle, so formal curriculum claims are controlled by the explicitly dated 2026–2027 guide. It confirms two sixty-credit compulsory years and Dutch, full-time BSc delivery. No formal route is selected; optional packages support additional interests without being inserted as mandatory components.

The base project entry is eighteen credits but its own course contents and choice rules expressly permit extension to twenty-four or thirty. The retained thirty-credit project uses twelve of the forty-two otherwise open credits, leaving thirty open. This is a single project, not an eighteen-plus-thirty double count. No guide aggregate or invented elective is used to fill the year. The external components total sixty per year and 180 uniquely.

Academic Basic Skills 1.1 precedes 1.2. Completing the full first year meets second-year forty-two-credit thresholds and all named first-year skills/methods conditions. Programming may be taken in period two, Experimental Psychology in period three and EEG in period four; the later molecular and neurophysiology practicals follow the recommended foundations. The Neurophysiology/Hodgkin-Huxley title change is a confirmed alias, not an omitted extra course.

Project entry is checked one month before starting and requires 120 EC, all sixty first-year EC, the philosophy/statistical-reasoning course, second-year review and five specified practicals. The study/career-orientation module is not one of the five. Completing both earlier years satisfies these exact conditions. Third-year programme electives require all first-year courses; at most twelve open credits may be introductory, and outside choices require non-overlap and prior approval. No placement host, topic or elective is fabricated.

The closest UCR response materially implements biological psychobiology: molecular/cellular foundations, evolution, neurobiology, physiology, pharmacology, genetics, perception, cognition, laboratory work and empirical/statistical methods, with development and mental-health perspectives. Replaced general philosophy, regional anatomy and philosophical emotion with evolution, laboratory biology and research methods. The cognitive-data option now has additional biological foundations and cell biology in place of robotics and persuasion. Its artificial networks/decision models are computational complements, not claims of biological mechanisms. The third option remains a coherent biological/disease response with a suitably bounded label.

All sixty-seven exact-target interests were reconciled. Two additional options have distinct content and pairwise differences of seventy-five, fifty-two-and-a-half and eighty-two-and-a-half EC each way. The evolutionary candidate remains supported but is not attempted after the maximum. Every selected course contribution was reconsidered from its actual profile or description, including description-only Perception/Action and Psycholinguistics.

Sixteen positive relationships identify meaningful subjects or disciplinary methods, with differences in scope explicit. Evolution matches Evolution/Behaviour, applied statistics matches the statistical-reasoning component, and meta-analysis matches the literature-review course. It is not a compulsory internship. Lifespan psychology is only a partial developmental relationship and does not claim embryology or cellular neurodevelopment. Dedicated EEG, neurophysiology practicals, bioethics and the required internship retain justified gaps; optional research is separate from scheduled credits.

Three original offering conflicts are repaired. Psycholinguistics is planned only in the first Spring and is placed there after Brain/Behavior, concurrently with Neurobiology; requiring Neurobiology earlier was tested and infeasible, but is not a formal gate. All actual formal prerequisites are earlier and offered terms verified. Neurobiology precedes Higher Order Functions, methods/data foundations precede advanced analyses, and all numerical requirements pass.

Read all twenty-five component labels, eight notes, three concepts, sixteen relationships, nine unmatched reasons and thirty-eight selected descriptions. Titles, source links and audience references resolve to the intended content. Shared code/name/text description reviews are reused only where unchanged; programme contributions were assessed separately. No app/renderer code, workbook or enrichment was changed. No screenshots, live modals or local runtime tests are claimed.
